title: Control Delivery Is Not Execution: A Reproducible AIREP Boundary Study
description: A reproducible author-side study separating control request, receipt, execution and observed effect claims. The deposit combines a frozen 24-case synthetic ACK-promotion comparison with an offline AIREP v0.2.0-beta.1 reference lane and six controlled LangGraph runtime scenarios. It does not establish third-party validation, production safety, same-version external interoperability, adoption or standards endorsement.
